title: Whydah Pirate Museum

services.name: General Admission
services.desc: Touch real pieces of eight. Walk the decks of a replica pirate ship. Come face to face with 300 years of hidden history. The Whydah Pirate Museum is home to the world’s only authenticated pirate treasure - discovered off the coast of Cape Cod. Explore gold and silver coins, weapons, and artifacts recovered from the wreck of Captain Samuel Bellamy’s legendary flagship, and discover the science and archaeology behind how they were recovered from the ocean floor and preserved for generations to

explain.meaning: Standard entry, without reserved seats or extras.

blurb: On April 26, 1717, a ferocious nor’easter slammed the Whydah Galley into the shoals off Cape Cod, taking nearly 150 men and millions in plundered treasure to the bottom - a story the ocean kept secret for nearly 300 years. In 1984, explorer Barry Clifford changed history, locating the wreck and authenticating the world’s only confirmed pirate shipwreck. The pirates were real.
